entries.title: TempoTrack working repository and baseline
not_supported: does not establish a new method's empirical result
entries.implementation_difference: Research code is an isolated pure-PyTorch package with optional MASA adapter.

entries.title: GOT-JEPA
method_supported: clean/corrupted teacher-student and prediction framing comparison
not_supported: not copied; no claim of first JEPA tracking
entries.implementation_difference: TempoTrack predicts tracklet identity representations from frozen detector features and uses a separate legal association solver.

entries.title: T-JEPA: A Joint-Embedding Predictive Architecture for Trajectory Similarity Computation
method_supported: trajectory-level predictive similarity is a relevant neighbor
not_supported: not an exact MOT fragment-reconnection reproduction
entries.implementation_difference: S1 uses frozen appearance plus geometry/time and adds identity, anti-collapse, and chain diagnostics under fixed observations.

entries.title: LeJEPA / SIGReg
not_supported: no copied code; no inherited theoretical guarantee
entries.implementation_difference: The current implementation uses a small VICReg-style regularizer, not an exact LeJEPA/SIGReg reproduction.

entries.title: I-JEPA
method_supported: context/target masking and EMA target design reference
not_supported: no large visual checkpoint and no claim of image JEPA reproduction
entries.implementation_difference: S1 applies the training idea to tracklet identity features and prevents target appearance from entering prediction.

entries.title: Flow Matching for Generative Modeling and official code
not_supported: no code copied into the Apache-2.0 repository
entries.implementation_difference: S2/S3 contain independent minimal PyTorch vector fields with explicit path-cover projection.

entries.title: Generative Point Tracking with Flow Matching
not_supported: point tracking is not fragment identity graph reconnection
entries.implementation_difference: S2 models a source identity's successor state; it does not modify detections or claim point-tracking reproduction.

entries.title: PermFlow
entries.implementation_difference: S3 uses sparse continuous edge flow plus birth/end dummy projection, not a square permutation manifold.

entries.title: DiffMOT
entries.implementation_difference: S2 is a frozen-observation successor-state control; it does not replace detector output.

entries.title: DIFUSCO
not_supported: TSP/MIS solver constraints are not copied to MOT
entries.implementation_difference: S4 has fixed valid-edge masks, MOT birth/death projection, and a separate EMD/GNN condition graph.

entries.title: Score matching and DiffusionTrack
not_supported: DiffusionTrack's detection/box setting is not reused as fixed-observation evidence
entries.implementation_difference: S4 explicitly trains VP DDPM epsilon prediction over edge states and projects the final graph legally.

entries.title: Query-MARFT
not_supported: no code copied; no result imported
entries.implementation_difference: S5 uses a single finite graph-edit environment, explicit masked BC and PPO, and a contingency-count reward.

entries.title: TCEI
entries.license: unverified; no root LICENSE found at inspected commit
not_supported: no code copied and no claim of first uncertainty memory
entries.implementation_difference: M1's causal controller is trained by future identity retrieval and exposes a separate utility ablation.

entries.title: SAM2RL
not_supported: not presented as an original first RL memory controller
entries.implementation_difference: M1 has constrained dual rates and an explicit read-match-assign-write causal integration into MASA.

entries.title: Neural MOT solver, MOTIP, VICReg, CPC
method_supported: graph association, identity prediction, anti-collapse, and predictive contrastive neighbors
entries.implementation_difference: The plan's novelty test is fixed-observation fragment reconnection with shared legal path projection, not generic neural MOT.

entries.title: MASA, TrackEval, TETA, TAO
entries.license: TrackEval MIT; TETA Apache-2.0; TAO code license inspected separately
method_supported: front-end call chain and official evaluation protocol
not_supported: no approximate evaluator is named as official
entries.implementation_difference: Research outputs remain ID-only and evaluator invocation is blocked unless the exact official dependency/payload is available.

entries.title: Codex official usage documentation
entries.implementation_difference: No model or code is copied.
